listing.name: Ultima VII Part Two: Serpent Isle (Exult)
listing.summary: Set up Ultima VII Part Two: Serpent Isle through its upstream exult player using your own original files. Setup, profiles and updates stay upstream-owned.
listing.original_game_title: Ultima VII Part Two: Serpent Isle

steps.title: Use this original game and edition
steps.instruction: Use your installed original Serpent Isle data, especially its complete STATIC folder. Silver Seed is optional and remains a separately owned add-on. Black Gate data does not supply Serpent Isle. Keep your originals elsewhere unchanged; upstream handles its own data recognition and preparation. A Portcove registration does not authenticate original-game files.

steps.title: Prepare upstream and select the real player
steps.instruction: Use the official Exult download/installer or a complete upstream-prepared player with its runtime data. The selected stable GitHub release has no binary assets; use upstream’s actual distribution route. Configure this installed game’s path in Exult, keeping Black Gate and Serpent Isle entries distinct. Register exult.exe with its installation folder as working directory, using the upstream game picker or the documented single argument --si. Do not register Exult Studio or a usecode/compiler helper as the player.

steps.title: Keep the actual original and player data
steps.instruction: On current Windows, exult.cfg normally lives under the actual Local AppData/Exult folder. Preserve the complete Exult profile and each game/mod’s configured savegame and gamedat locations, including any path overrides and original STATIC data. Keep optional add-ons separate from base-game choices. Close all copies before upstream updates; preserve the creating runtime until its game/mod saves work in a replacement.

steps.title: Keep external ownership and deliberate Play
steps.instruction: Finish upstream setup first. Registration saves your selected executable, working directory and literal arguments; Play is a separate explicit action. You and upstream own this external runtime, original files and profile. Registration-only removal preserves them. Managed Update, Backup, Rollback, migration and deletion are not offered for these external files. Preserve a working copy and its data before upstream replacement. Other platforms require their own supported upstream application/native flow.
